specification: B1 permanent registry (briefs/b1-any-age-contract.md section 1): every installed validator epoch is kept forever, looked up directly by epoch; append-only with a durable imported-tip cursor; no window, ring, queue, pruning or deletion; no layout-version word (b1.format = 2)

cursors.genesisEpoch: b1.genesisEpoch = g, the first epoch of this deployment (zero is a valid occupied epoch; an absent word reads zero)
cursors.importedTipEpoch: b1.importedTipEpoch = I, the greatest contiguously installed epoch; the durable import cursor (count = I - g + 1, derived)
cursors.originReady: b1.originReady = 0 before the first usable root origin, 1 thereafter; the usable origin is origin.rootEpoch (U) and clock.rootRound (O), with g <= U = I once ready

member.formula: M(e,j,f) = keccak256(abi.encode(F("b1.member"), uint256(e), uint256(j), uint256(f))), j < memberCount
member.encoding: nodeID bytes in wire order, left-aligned, zero right padding; key = 33-byte compressed secp256k1 key in key0 (bytes 0..31) and the top byte of key1 (byte 32), rest zero

bounds.maxAddressedWords: 139 * (I - g + 1) + 7 fixed words, growing by 139 words per installed epoch and never shrinking (excludes the operational slots)

genesisStorage.name: genesisCommitment
genesisStorage.value: SHA-256(CBOR(G)), with G built over this codeHash (#153 §5.3 step 2)

genesisStorage.name: assignment.activeConfHash
genesisStorage.value: fullShardConfHash (same as immutable genesis configuration hash)

genesisStorage.name: b1.genesisEpoch
genesisStorage.value: genesis epoch g (a zero epoch is an absent word)

genesisStorage.name: b1.importedTipEpoch
genesisStorage.value: genesis epoch (I = g; a zero epoch is an absent word); b1.originReady is 0 and absent

genesisStorage.name: b1.entry(genesis epoch)
genesisStorage.value: the authenticated genesis entry: present=1, activationCommitID=0, hasEnd=0, memberCount, totalWeight

genesisStorage.name: b1.member(genesis epoch, j)
genesisStorage.value: full members under the root consensus keys, 8 words each

genesisNote: Zero words are absent from a genesis allocation. The genesis builder (src/B1GenesisBuilder.sol) applies the runtime bounds to the genesis entry and refuses B > 2 with UnmeasuredB, G_rest below the measured-plus-margin allowance, or g_sys below the envelope. This artifact does not contain a deployable genesis record: genesisCommitment, fullShardConfHash and the entry members depend on deployment configuration and are produced by the Go construction using codeHash above.

gRestBound.basis: Measured-plus-margin, not proven: maximal actual-call fixtures at B = 0, 1, 2 (16-member entries, three node-ID shapes); ureth must re-measure under the real client and may lower or raise the constants before activation
gRestBound.covers: everything in open + finalize except the history SSTOREs of the rectangle (139*B entry words, the two closure words of the former tip and the two cursor words, each at 22100, nothing cleared): SLOADs, hashing, decode, memory, logs, operational-registry writes (28, each priced at 22100) and finalize
gRestBound.price: Cancun, cold: SLOAD 2100, SSTORE 22100 set / 5000 reset, gross (no refund credit)
